title: Ninth Row — Nocturne Film-inspired Event Site

logo.source: wordmark set in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed; favicon src/app/icon.svg
logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon. Until the owner’s own exists: the name set as a wordmark in the display face, and its first letter as the favicon — no invented symbol to throw away later. The favicon is a file (src/app/icon.svg, the letter as a path), never a generated icon route: one that fetches a font at build time breaks static hosting and builds without a network (Kelp Line)

typefaces.specs: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, Sofia Sans Condensed, Sofia Sans (Google Fonts)

finalCopy.source: src/content/*.ts — every line marked PLACEHOLDER waits for the owner
finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words

heroVideo.specs: 1920×1080 min, 10–20 s, one continuous move, not a loop, no text burned in

posterImage.usage: Shown before video loads and on reduced motion
posterImage.specs: First frame of the video, same crop

mobileVideoEncode.usage: Hero on small screens — made from the hero video by scripts/prepare-video.sh

scrubReadyEncode.specs: Made by scripts/prepare-video.sh from the ORIGINAL file: CRF 20, keyframe every 6 frames, ≤ 1920 px
